title: HideBox
summary: Browser-encrypted file drive with link, word, address and pay-to-open sharing. November 5 review: creator revision 0b7e341 updates Ootle libraries to 0.49.2 after the November 2 Esmeralda reset. The public site reports that revision, and the creator-documented replacement SealLog component resolves in Veil with recent events. The public status endpoint reports green checks with a budget-reservation attention flag; this is the service’s own status report. Losing the saved browser key loses access. The server sees padded sizes, timing and sharing rules; sponsored sends can be linked, and a deletion receipt cannot prove no copy was kept. Refund-backed payments remain roadmap work. Original forum, Reddit and Bluesky discussions are readable; X exposes one of three counted replies. The retained October 23 recording shows the unchanged how-it-works page and illustrative UI, not a file upload or payment. No drive, keys, wallet, uploads or payments were created. MIT source; Esmeralda testnet only.
cardSummary: Store encrypted files and share them through links, recipient addresses or paid access on Ootle testnet.
